title: A duplicate key that comes before a syntax error is the error reported
notes: The input has two faults, a duplicate key and an unclosed flow mapping after it. The specification does not rank faults, so the kit's convention is the one a reader that builds values as it reads has: the first fault in the text is the one reported. The duplicate key is semantic, so no position is stated. The category is `duplicate-key`, not `syntax`.

provenance.reference: A reader that parsed the whole stream before building values and so reported the later syntax error.
